# NSTLD
> Domain registration and DNS services for country-code and generic top-level domains.

NSTLD provides domain name registration, DNS hosting, WHOIS lookup, and related registry services for businesses and individuals managing internet domains.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://nstld.com/): Overview of NSTLD domain registration, DNS, and related internet naming services.
- [About](https://nstld.com/about): Company background, mission, and information about NSTLD services.
- [Contact](https://nstld.com/contact): Contact details and inquiry options for sales, support, and general questions.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://nstld.com/whois): Search domain registration records and ownership information.
- [DNS Services](https://nstld.com/dns): Information about DNS hosting and domain resolution services.
- [Domain Registration](https://nstld.com/domains): Browse domain registration offerings and supported extensions.

## Domain Services
- [Register a Domain](https://nstld.com/domains/register): Start a new domain registration through NSTLD.
- [Transfer a Domain](https://nstld.com/domains/transfer): Move an existing domain registration to NSTLD.
- [Renew a Domain](https://nstld.com/domains/renew): Renew active domain registrations and manage expiration.
- [Domain Pricing](https://nstld.com/domains/pricing): Review registration, transfer, and renewal pricing information.
- [Supported TLDs](https://nstld.com/domains/tlds): Explore available top-level domains and registration options.

## DNS and Hosting
- [Managed DNS](https://nstld.com/dns/managed): Details about managed DNS hosting and record management.
- [DNS Management](https://nstld.com/dns/manage): Tools and options for editing DNS records.
- [Nameserver Setup](https://nstld.com/dns/nameservers): Configure nameservers for domains hosted with NSTLD.
- [DNSSEC](https://nstld.com/dns/dnssec): Information about DNSSEC support and domain security.
- [Zone File Management](https://nstld.com/dns/zones): Manage DNS zone files and related settings.

## Account and Support
- [Login](https://nstld.com/login): Access the NSTLD customer account and management portal.
- [Create Account](https://nstld.com/signup): Register a new NSTLD customer account.
- [Support Center](https://nstld.com/support): Get help with account, billing, and domain management issues.
- [Knowledge Base](https://nstld.com/support/kb): Browse help articles and self-service documentation.
- [FAQ](https://nstld.com/faq): Answers to common questions about domains, DNS, and account management.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://nstld.com/terms): Terms governing use of NSTLD services and website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nstld.com/privacy): How NSTLD collects, uses, and protects personal information.
- [Refund Policy](https://nstld.com/refunds): Rules and conditions for service refunds and cancellations.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://nstld.com/aup): Usage restrictions and prohibited activities for NSTLD services.
- [ICANN Information](https://nstld.com/icann): Registrar obligations, rights, and ICANN-related information.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://nstld.com/blog): Articles and updates about domains, DNS, and internet infrastructure.
- [Announcements](https://nstld.com/news): Company news, service updates, and operational notices.
- [Domain Search](https://nstld.com/search): Search for available domain names and extensions.
- [Status Page](https://nstld.com/status): Service availability and incident reporting for NSTLD systems.
- [Help Guides](https://nstld.com/guides): Practical guides for domain setup, DNS, and account tasks.
